programs.desc: The profile of Elon Musk, a well-known multi-billionaire, called a technological prophet, who is behind companies such as PayPal, SpaceX, Tesla, Neuralink and Boring Company.The film presents his visions of new, world-revolutionizing solutions.It shows how from a start-up founder he became a billionaire who plans to spend his old age on Mars.It tells not only about the times when Musk was successful and made a fortune, but also about the past and business failures that shaped him and influenced his character.
